record.label: Lean Comparator and the candidate definition holes
record.statement: The authors report that they ran Lean Comparator in a clean sandbox to compare each submission with the frozen specification, check its axioms and verify the stated resource bound.
record.boundary: The challenge fixes the cost predicate and theorem statements. The candidate supplies the workspace size, circuit, and numerical bound in the three definition holes named in the configuration. The authors report running Comparator against the frozen specification with the remaining definitions fixed.
